notes.title: Emperial Knights Patch 7.5
notes.content:
Revamp of the core of the gameplay mechanics and movements.


-Combat Systems & Skills System

-Archery System

-Blocking System

-Trajectory of the movements matching with animations
 and motion warping on combat attacks.

-Fluid Animations and optimization of the bugs.

Soon AI will be released, i am currently working on it.
